rows.title: Typed primitives and formal core
rows.acceptance_criterion: OC primitives and readiness predicates are represented in Lean or a source-bound proof ledger.
rows.allowed_wording: OC has a bounded formal proof ledger.
rows.forbidden_wording: OC is not an unbounded empirical law.
rows.verification_note: 042 control reports terminal rows and no bad statuses.

rows.title: Central theorem/boundary and overclaim guard
rows.acceptance_criterion: The central OC statement is expressed with its repaired boundary and the old universal overclaim remains refuted.
rows.allowed_wording: OC central claims may be stated only at 042 ceiling.
rows.forbidden_wording: No unconditional proof across all reality.
rows.verification_note: Boundary artifact exists and is linked to DB.

rows.title: Operator, K, domain, and crown proof graph
rows.acceptance_criterion: Internal contours and crown/domain closures have DB-backed proof, counterproof, or repaired-proof rows.
rows.allowed_wording: OC has closed bounded contour ledgers.
rows.forbidden_wording: No crown/domain promotion from vocabulary alone.

rows.title: Negative results and countermodels
rows.acceptance_criterion: Refuted old formulations and repaired claims remain explicit guards.
rows.allowed_wording: Negative results are part of the theory boundary.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not hide refuted claims by rewriting history.

rows.title: Reproducible formal and executable artifacts
rows.acceptance_criterion: Lean and Python validators/witnesses exist for the proof/evidence chain.
rows.allowed_wording: Reproducibility is validator-backed.
rows.forbidden_wording: No proof claim from prose-only artifacts.
rows.verification_note: Prior validators are present and callable.

rows.title: Bounded journal thesis
rows.acceptance_criterion: One journal-safe thesis states OC as a bounded formal/evidence metamodel, not a total empirical law.
rows.allowed_wording: Journal paper can be prepared around bounded OC thesis.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not submit a universal empirical proof claim.
rows.verification_note: Thesis packet and proof boundary exist.

rows.title: Current related-work and venue fit
rows.acceptance_criterion: A current literature and target-journal venue scan is attached with contribution boundary and citation gaps.
rows.blocker: Run current literature/venue refresh before send.
rows.allowed_wording: Article is publication-preparable.
rows.forbidden_wording: Article is not journal-sendable without current related-work/venue gate.
rows.verification_note: No current 2026 venue/literature refresh artifact is bound in 044 inputs.

rows.title: Theorem/evidence table and reproducibility appendix
rows.acceptance_criterion: Article has exact theorem/evidence rows, formal artifacts, dataset/replay refs, and reproduction commands.
rows.allowed_wording: Article may cite bounded proof/evidence ledgers.
rows.forbidden_wording: No theorem without artifact ref.

rows.title: Reviewer attack map
rows.acceptance_criterion: Known reviewer attacks are represented and mapped to responses/limitations.
rows.allowed_wording: Reviewer map can be used as support artifact.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not ignore known attacks.

rows.title: Owner-send and ethics/disclosure gate
rows.acceptance_criterion: Owner approves target venue/send package and disclosure/ethics requirements are checked.
rows.blocker: Owner-send decision and ethics/disclosure review are external gates.
rows.allowed_wording: No-send draft may be prepared.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not send as journal submission before owner gate.

rows.title: Cumulative argument and chapter reader jobs
rows.acceptance_criterion: Book chapters declare reader job, narrative arc, claim/evidence, limitation, and next question.
rows.blocker: Existing monograph must be remapped to 042/044 claims and checked chapter-by-chapter.
rows.allowed_wording: Monograph source exists as a draft corpus.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not call the monograph book-ready until remapped and leakage-audited.
rows.verification_note: Existing contract defines the standard; current book artifact is not yet 044-certified.

rows.title: Glossary, notation, proof/evidence appendices
rows.acceptance_criterion: Definitions, notation, proof ledger, counterproofs, datasets/replays, and limitations are visible to a reader.
rows.allowed_wording: Appendix material exists for a bounded monograph.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not omit negative results.

rows.title: Reader-facing leakage and internal jargon audit
rows.acceptance_criterion: Book text contains no internal path/gate/generator leakage and translates DB status into reader language.
rows.blocker: Run and fix a reader-facing leakage/style audit for the assembled monograph.
rows.allowed_wording: Book can be prepared after audit.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not publish internal control prose as book prose.
rows.verification_note: 044 has not yet run a monograph text audit.

rows.title: Book release owner and rights gate
rows.acceptance_criterion: Owner approves book/publication boundary, rights, acknowledgements, AI disclosure, and public/private exclusions.
rows.blocker: Owner/publication rights gate is required before book release.
rows.allowed_wording: Private book manuscript can be prepared.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not publish as book before owner/release gate.
rows.verification_note: Master book keeps public release blocked.

rows.title: Public-safe novelty statement
rows.acceptance_criterion: Novelty is stated without universal overclaim, fake empirical language, or marketing certainty.
rows.allowed_wording: OC is a bounded, proof/evidence-ledger metamodel.
rows.forbidden_wording: OC is not fully empirically proved across all reality.

rows.title: Limitations and old-claim guards
rows.acceptance_criterion: Rejected strong formulations remain visible as guardrails.
rows.allowed_wording: Limitations can be publicly named.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not reintroduce old crown/domain overclaims.

rows.title: Domain-to-OC operational protocol
rows.acceptance_criterion: Protocol maps source statement, observables, constraints, operators, falsifier, evidence ceiling, and output boundary.
rows.allowed_wording: OC can be used for bounded internal domain/claim analysis.
rows.forbidden_wording: Protocol does not validate domains without evidence.

rows.title: Data intake and refusal conditions
rows.acceptance_criterion: Required and recommended EA data packages are specified with refusal/no-send conditions.
rows.allowed_wording: Analysis can request a concrete input package.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not infer missing client facts.
rows.verification_note: EA data package and case corpus exist.

rows.title: Replay and failure-mode examples
rows.acceptance_criterion: At least one replay/example path demonstrates success and failure/no-send behavior.
rows.allowed_wording: Internal replay-backed use is available.
rows.forbidden_wording: No empirical promotion without replay/data.

rows.title: Scientific core integration path
rows.acceptance_criterion: Toolkit discovers and runs the canonical scientific core through a deterministic path.
rows.allowed_wording: Toolkit has a canonical core integration contract.
rows.forbidden_wording: No parallel ad-hoc scientific pipeline.

rows.title: EAQ feature registry and question selector
rows.acceptance_criterion: All EAQ question rows have feature registry entries and prioritization metadata.
rows.allowed_wording: Toolkit can enumerate the question surface.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not hide in-progress EAQ rows.

rows.title: Mapper modules: variables/operators/falsifiers/evidence
rows.acceptance_criterion: Runtime modules expose intake, OC variable mapping, operator mapping, falsifier generation, evidence binding, replay runner, boundary checker, and report emitter.
rows.blocker: Existing materials define pieces, but 044 requires one consolidated Toolkit module contract and runtime acceptance tests for every module.
rows.allowed_wording: Toolkit requirements are now concrete.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not call Estra Toolkit ready before module contract/tests pass.
rows.verification_note: No 044 consolidated module-runtime acceptance artifact exists yet.

rows.title: Toolkit UI/API QA and no-send gates
rows.acceptance_criterion: The user-facing or API workflow has QA, failure messages, no-send gates, and reproducible end-to-end examples.
rows.blocker: Run current Toolkit UI/API verification against 044 requirements and repair failures.
rows.allowed_wording: Internal workflow spec exists.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not call Toolkit product-ready without current QA.
rows.verification_note: Gate artifact exists, but 044 has not certified current UI/API behavior.

rows.title: External user tests and support model
rows.acceptance_criterion: At least one bounded user workflow has acceptance test, service-level/support rules, and owner-approved release boundary.
rows.blocker: Requires owner release decision and user/workflow validation.
rows.allowed_wording: Toolkit can remain internal/pilot-prep.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not sell or externally release from internal readiness.
rows.verification_note: Master and offer catalog keep external gates.

rows.title: Complete target customer question atlas
rows.acceptance_criterion: The EA target question surface is represented exactly once with tiers, clusters, failure modes, mechanisms, data refs, and readiness.
rows.allowed_wording: EA Second Opinion has a concrete question surface.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not use a partial or hidden question list.

rows.title: Behavior classes that matter to the CTO/EA audience
rows.acceptance_criterion: Question atlas covers load survivability, hidden dependencies, boundary collapse, retry storms, failover state corruption, observability, migration risk, portfolio priority, governance, AI/automation, and safe standardization.
rows.allowed_wording: EA behavior coverage is explicit.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not market a narrower accidental slice as complete.
rows.verification_note: Behavior classes are recovered from EA ladder clusters/failure causes.

rows.title: Data intake, replay, and report packet
rows.acceptance_criterion: Second Opinion has required data package, case/replay refs, and a client/report deliverable template.
rows.allowed_wording: EA Second Opinion can be specified as a bounded diagnostic packet.
rows.forbidden_wording: Data package does not create client-safe outcome proof.

rows.title: Close in-progress EAQ chains
rows.acceptance_criterion: EAQ_101, EAQ_102, and EAQ_103 must have complete science/client/product/publication chains before full EA2O readiness.
rows.allowed_wording: Current bounded packets may be used internally with provisional boundary.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not call full EA2O ready while chains remain in progress.

rows.title: Client-safe and external validation boundary
rows.acceptance_criterion: Client-safe claims require external client proof and owner approval beyond internal simulations.
rows.blocker: External client evidence and owner gate required.
rows.allowed_wording: EA Second Opinion may be pilot-prep/internal.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not promise client outcomes or ROI.
rows.verification_note: Master and client gate keep external blocker.

rows.title: Bounded workflow spec
rows.acceptance_criterion: A product workflow has inputs, outputs, QA checks, no-send gate, and non-goals.
rows.allowed_wording: A bounded internal workflow exists.
rows.forbidden_wording: Not an externally sellable product by itself.

rows.title: Runtime links and executable examples
rows.acceptance_criterion: Workflow rows bind to runtime nodes, simulation commands, and packet refs.
rows.allowed_wording: Product packets can be traced to runtime refs.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not rely on untraceable demos.

rows.title: QA, UX/API, failure messages, and support model
rows.acceptance_criterion: Current user workflow has tested UX/API acceptance, failure messages, service boundaries, support/runbook.
rows.blocker: Produce current product QA runbook and acceptance test for the selected workflow.
rows.allowed_wording: Internal workflow can guide implementation.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not call product-ready until QA/support pass.
rows.verification_note: 044 has no current UX/API/support acceptance artifact.

rows.title: Planning/pilot business package boundary
rows.acceptance_criterion: Offer catalog and master book separate planning/pilot value from sales claims.
rows.allowed_wording: Use for internal planning and pilot preparation.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not treat pilot-prep as sales proof.
rows.verification_note: Offer catalog explicitly names planning/pilot and blockers.

rows.title: ROI, market, pricing, and client proof
rows.acceptance_criterion: Commercial claims require external market/pricing/client evidence and owner approval.
rows.blocker: Acquire external client/market evidence and owner approval.
rows.allowed_wording: Commercial work can remain pre-market.
rows.forbidden_wording: No ROI/revenue/client-safe promises.
rows.verification_note: Master and offer catalog block GA/commercial claims.

rows.title: Legal, FTO, counsel, and public-release gate
rows.acceptance_criterion: Legal/FTO/public release claims require counsel/IP review and release decision.
rows.blocker: Counsel/IP/FTO review and owner release gate required.
rows.allowed_wording: Internal business plan may cite blockers.
rows.forbidden_wording: No legal/FTO/public-release claim.

rows.title: Owner/board control book and no-send gates
rows.acceptance_criterion: Master book carries owner-click, no-send, evidence/gap, and decision boundary.
rows.allowed_wording: Governance can use the readiness atlas internally.
rows.forbidden_wording: Governance does not prove external claims.

rows.title: Evidence registry and traceability
rows.acceptance_criterion: Readiness rows bind to source refs, proof/evidence refs, and validators.
rows.allowed_wording: Traceability exists across 042/043/044.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not accept untraceable readiness claims.

rows.title: RACI/role ownership and external decision logs
rows.acceptance_criterion: External publication/commercial actions need signed owner/counsel/client decision records.
rows.blocker: Add current signed owner/counsel/client decision logs for external actions.
rows.allowed_wording: Internal owner review can continue.
rows.forbidden_wording: Do not externalize without decision records.
rows.verification_note: Current 044 inputs do not include fresh signed external decision logs.
